# Get document info kick

Source: https://github.com/xyleme-sidekick/get-info-kick/blob/main/README.md

# Get document info kick

This is implementation of custom kick, supposed to be used inside Xyleme Sidekick.
All what it's doing is just showing extended information about selected documents.
It can be used as an example for creating your own custom kick or even multiple kicks.

Here are key points you need to know to do so:

- implement custom kick interface
- setup module federation configuration

## Implement custom kick interface

In order to export your custom kicks, you should export "registerKicks" function, which returns your kicks:

```js
export const registerKicks = (): RegisteredKicks => {
  return {
    kicks: [registerGetInfoKick()],
  };
};
```
You may export multiple kicks. Here is "registerGetInfoKick" function:
```js
export const registerGetInfoKick = (): RegisteredKick => {
  return {
    // ID of your kick (should be unique)
    id: 'getInfoKick',
    // kick name
    name: 'Get Info',
    // kick description
    description: 'Get the selected items info',
    // position inside Sidekick kick list
    position: 6000,
    // custom kick implementation
    component: GetInfoKick,
    // optional user role(s), who can use your kick
    userRoles: ['getInfo Role'],
  };
};
```

Custom kick component should have the following props:

```js
export interface KickProps {
  onReady: (result: RegisterKickResult) => void;
  xyFetch: typeof fetch;
}
```
**onReady** - once your component is ready, it should call it and pass function, which will be used to activate/execute your custom kick:

```js
const execute = useCallback(
  (items: SidekickItem[]) => {
    // do kick work here
  },
  [xyFetch]
);

useEffect(() => {
  onReady({ execute });
}, [onReady, execute]);
```

**xyFetch** - may be used to send requests to Xyleme API


## Setup module federation configuration

We are using [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/) as a bundler and [@originjs/vite-plugin-federation](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@originjs/vite-plugin-federation) plugin to support module federation feature.
Here is a part of Vite config file:

```js
import federation from "@originjs/vite-plugin-federation";

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => ({
  plugins: [
    federation({
      // you can give any name you would like
      name: "kicks",
      // you can give a name to js file
      filename: "kicks.js",
      exposes: {
        // left side should remain unchanged, right side - path to module with your custom kicks
        "./Kicks": "./src/features/index.ts",
      },
      // shared libraries, keep it unchanged
      shared: ["react", "react-dom"],
    })
  ]
})
```
